integrity: The proof reconstructs the top cellular coboundary of a good coarse orbifold triangulation and combines it with the source's Proposition 8.7. No enumeration or numerical experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result proves an upper bound of rank \(8\) and a rank-\(4\) nonorientable example, but does not decide whether any closed nonorientable smooth five-orbifold with both stabilizer types requires rank \(8\). The top-cohomology argument is confined to the top degree.
title: Rank-eight upper bound for nonorientable five-orbifolds
